notes:
EmStat Control is now part of LacBench, with BathBot and LacTracker. LacTracker: markers anywhere on the chart, zoom each axis on its own, and fixes for Windows.

- Click the chart to add a marker at that moment, while recording, after Stop, and when reviewing a saved session.
- Shift + scroll wheel zooms the value axis; the scroll wheel (or Ctrl + wheel) zooms time. The I_SENSE axis fits what is on screen.
- Marker keys 1–9 and 0 work on Windows (they stopped after clicking a button), also from the numpad.
- The memory reading updates after a purge.
- On small screens the window scrolls, so nothing at the bottom is out of reach; long dialogs scroll too.
- Wider list of set markers beside the chart.
